description_en: Recognizes global identity documents through OCR
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl doc-ocr-max --product-code ID_OCR_MAX --merchant-biz-id e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c000000 --doc-type CNSSC01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DocOcrMax

parameters.help_en:
The product solution to use.

Set this parameter to ID_OCR_MAX
parameters.help_zh:
要接入的产品方案。

取值ID_OCR_MAX
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The custom authentication scenario ID. You can use this scenario ID to query related records in the console.

The value can contain up to 10 characters, including letters, digits, and underscores
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录。

支持长度为10位的字母、数字和下划线的组合
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en:
The custom unique business identifier, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting.

The value can contain up to 32 characters, including letters and digits. Make sure the value is unique
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题。

支持长度为32位的字母和数字的组合，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom user ID or another identifier that can identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address.

We strongly recommend that you desensitize the value of this field in advance, for example, by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的用户ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如：手机号码、邮箱地址等。

强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded image of the card or certificate.

If you use IdOcrPictureBase64 to pass in the document image, check the image size and do not pass in an excessively large image
parameters.help_zh:
卡证图片Base64编码。

如果您选择IdOcrPictureBase64（照片Base64编码）方式传入证件照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the card or certificate image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 卡证图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The OCR recognition mode. Valid values:

0: general document recognition mode (default).

1: automatic document classification mode.

2: automatic document classification + general recognition mode
parameters.help_zh:
OCR识别模式：

0：通用证件识别模式（默认）

1：证件自动分类模式

2：证件自动分类+通用识别模式
parameters.name: ocr_model

parameters.help_en:
The document type.
Format: country code + document type abbreviation + page (optional).

Note:
OcrModel = 0: DocType is required. Specify the document type. The existing logic remains unchanged.
OcrModel = 1 or 2: DocType must be left empty
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型。
格式：国家（地区）代码+证件类型缩写+页面（可选）

说明
OcrModel = 0：DocType必传，指定证件类型，现有逻辑不变
OcrModel = 1或2：DocType需要为空
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom OCR quality detection threshold mode. Valid values:

0: system default.
1: strict mode.
2: loose mode.
3 (default): quality detection disabled
parameters.help_zh:
自定义OCR质量检测阈值模式：

0：系统默认
1：严格模式
2：宽松模式
3（默认）：关闭质量检测
parameters.name: id_threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the document anti-forgery feature. Valid values:

T: enabled.

F (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启证件防伪功能：

T：开启

F（默认）：不开启
parameters.name: id_spoof

parameters.help_en:
The expected page to recognize. Valid values:

01 (default): the portrait side of the document.

02: the back side of the document
parameters.help_zh:
期望识别的页面

01（默认）：证件人像面

02：证件背面
parameters.name: doc_page

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable OCR key field standardization. Valid values:
0: no (default). 
1: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要开启OCR识别关键字段标准化
0：否 (默认) 
1：是
parameters.name: ocr_value_standard

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable authoritative data source verification to enhance document anti-forgery capabilities.

T: enabled.

F: disabled (default).


Applicable document types: China resident identity card (CHN01001) and Chinese mainland driver's license (CHN02001).
Data transmission statement: Enabling this parameter indicates your consent to transmit the user's name and document number to an authoritative data source in the Chinese mainland for consistency verification.
Performance impact: After this feature is enabled, the API response time increases by approximately 1 to 2 seconds. Adjust the timeout settings accordingly
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用权威数据源核验以增强证件防伪能力。

T：启用

F：不启用（默认值）


适用证件类型：中国居民身份证（CHN01001）、中国内地驾驶证（CHN02001）。
数据传输声明：启用此参数，即表示同意将用户的姓名和证件号码传输至中国内地权威数据源进行一致性校验。
性能影响：启用后，接口响应时间将增加约 1-2 秒。建议调整超时时间设置
parameters.name: authorize

ExtIdInfo.description_en: The card and certificate recognition result. This parameter is returned only when the API response is successful
ExtIdInfo.description_zh: 卡证识别结果只有当接口响应成功时返回

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the authentication is passed. Valid values:

Y: passed.
N: not passed
Passed.description_zh:
认证是否通过。

Y：通过。
N：不通过
